intended_use: Passive review of completed multi-donor DE artifacts; bounded evidence and warrant records, not scientific authorization
claim_support: Single-gene table assertions, separately evaluated clauses and scoped limitations; ambiguous prose requires review
fix_policy: Latest supported 1.x minor; earlier-minor critical backports within 90 days and never beyond published EOL
rule_change_policy: Corrections retain rule IDs, counterexamples, affected contexts and reassessment notices; breaking meanings require a new contract identifier and migration
